```{r Data Download}
nfl_analytics <- read.csv("/Users/joshkornell/Downloads/supplementary_data.csv")

library(dplyr)
```

```{r Pass Patterns}
depth_patterns <- list(
  short = regex("\\b(short pass|short to|screen to|screen pass|dump off|checkdown|swing pass|swing to|swing left|swing right|swing)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE),
  deep  = regex("\\b(deep pass|deep to|deep left|deep right|bomb to|bomb|long pass|go route|deep middle|deep center)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
)

left_pat   <- regex("\\b(left|toward left|to the left|left side)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
right_pat  <- regex("\\b(right|toward right|to the right|right side)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
middle_pat <- regex("\\b(middle|center|centre|up the middle|middle of the field|inside)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
```

```{r Adding directional variables}
#Clean Data
nfl_analytics_clean <- nfl_analytics %>%
  filter(!is.na(pass_result),
         play_nullified_by_penalty == "N") %>%
  mutate(
    sd = coalesce(play_description, "") %>% str_squish(),

    # direction
    pass_dir = case_when(
      str_detect(sd, left_pat)   ~ "left",
      str_detect(sd, right_pat)  ~ "right",
      str_detect(sd, middle_pat) ~ "middle",
      TRUE                       ~ "unknown"
    ),

    # depth
    pass_depth = case_when(
      str_detect(sd, depth_patterns$short) ~ "short",
      str_detect(sd, depth_patterns$deep)  ~ "deep",
      # heuristics: if pass_length exists and numeric -> use pass_length breakpoint
      !is.na(pass_length) & pass_length <= 7    ~ "short",
      !is.na(pass_length) & pass_length >= 16   ~ "deep",
      !is.na(pass_length) & pass_length > 7 & pass_length < 16 ~ "medium",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),

    # combined tag
    pass_outcome = str_c(pass_depth, pass_dir, sep = "_") # e.g. "short_left"
  ) %>%
  # keep only meaningful outcomes (drop unknown if you want)
  mutate(
    pass_depth = factor(pass_depth, levels = c("short","medium","deep","unknown")),
    pass_dir   = factor(pass_dir,   levels = c("left","middle","right","unknown")),
    pass_outcome = factor(pass_outcome)
  )
```
